method: Official public GitHub repository pages, public raw files and workflow/release pages. REST API responses were HTTP 403; page display counts are rounded and are not represented as exact API statistics.

chosen.reason: Mature community-maintained service categories and recent daily successful publication, with current Claude and Antigravity coverage. A strict local format adapter is required; upstream does not claim native Surge support.
chosen.popularity_limit: Stars, forks and community examples establish recognition, not active user counts, an objective quality score, or a guarantee.

repositories.compatibility: classical OpenAI includes one DOMAIN-REGEX unsupported by Surge; plain geosite uses Clash +.domain syntax. Never point Surge directly at these raw files.
repositories.decision: primary AI domain upstream with strict deterministic adapter
keep mature ChatGPT voice IP source; aggregate domain AI file does not preserve independent per-service policies
high recognition but inspected individual AI lists lack current coverage; large star count alone does not justify these particular files
mature wider ecosystem, sparse inspected individual AI lists
separate files do not improve the required completeness
not used in this revision; replaced under user preference for mature upstream
not used as any update dependency

independent_community_examples.context: Firsthand discussion asking for separate LLM rules; a participant recommends MetaCubeX geosite.
Participants recommend MetaCubeX and blackmatrix as rule-provider sources.

regex_scope_note: Only the reviewed chatgpt-async-webps-prod regex is translated. Surge wildcard covers every valid hostname match of that regex but deliberately permits non-digits after the initial numeric suffix character; this bounded widening is documented and tested.
source_lock_note: Raw response snapshots plus SHA256 and complete transform inputs are retained. Exact upstream git commit was not independently observed, so source-lock.json explicitly uses commit_sha:null.

checkout.setup_python: not used; Python standard library only
